Container.Name: MediaWiki
Container.Overview:
MediaWiki is the free, open-source wiki engine that powers Wikipedia. This template runs the OFFICIAL MediaWiki Docker image (default tag: stable = newest stable release, currently 1.46; use tag 'lts' for the long-term-support 1.43 line, or pin a specific version like '1.44').
=== FIRST-RUN SETUP === 1) Leave the "LocalSettings.php" path BLANK for the very first start (mounting a not-yet-existing file makes Docker create a folder by that name, which breaks MediaWiki). 2) Start the container and open the WebUI. Complete the setup wizard. For the database choose SQLite (simplest - writes to the mapped /var/www/html/data folder) OR an external MySQL/MariaDB server (recommended for anything you care about). 3) At the end of the wizard, download the generated LocalSettings.php and save it into your appdata folder (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/mediawiki/LocalSettings.php). 4) Edit this container, set the "LocalSettings.php" path to that file, and restart. The wiki is live.
=== EXTENSIONS === The image already bundles the common extensions (VisualEditor, WikiEditor, CodeMirror, Cite, ParserFunctions, Scribunto, SyntaxHighlight, TemplateData, ConfirmEdit, ImageMap, InputBox, Poem, PdfHandler and more). Enable them with wfLoadExtension('...') lines in LocalSettings.php. Non-bundled extensions (e.g. PluggableAuth + OpenID Connect for SSO, Mermaid for diagrams) are added under /var/www/html/extensions - map the "Extensions" path to persist them. See the repo README.
=== MULTIPLE WIKIS / DATABASE === Run one container per wiki (own appdata folder, own host port, own reverse-proxy URL). Several low-traffic wikis can share one MariaDB server, each with its own database. See the repo README for a full walk-through.
Container.Requires: Needs a database: SQLite (built in, no extra container) or an external MySQL/MariaDB server.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port for the wiki. Point your reverse proxy at this port.

Config.Name: Uploads (images)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for uploaded files and images. Required.

Config.Name: SQLite data dir
Config.Description: Holds the wiki database file IF you choose SQLite during setup. Harmless to keep mapped even when using MySQL/MariaDB.

Config.Name: LocalSettings.php
Config.Description: LEAVE BLANK ON FIRST RUN. After completing the setup wizard, save the downloaded LocalSettings.php to your appdata folder and set this path to it, then restart.

Config.Name: Extensions (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: map a folder here to persist add-on (non-bundled) extensions across image updates, e.g. PluggableAuth, OpenIDConnect, Mermaid.

Config.Name: Skins (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: map a folder here to persist custom skins across image updates.

Config.Name: PHP upload max size
Config.Description: Optional PHP override (e.g. 64M) for larger uploads. Also raise $wgMaxUploadSize in LocalSettings.php.
